name: Jaedenar
summary: Cultists and demons now hold Jaedenar, the Shadow Council’s chief base in northern Kalimdor. Blighted woodland covers ancient night elf ruins and druidic barrow dens, with the Shadow Hold below.

sections.title: A Bastion of Fel Worship
sections.body: Night elf sacred grounds and barrow dens once filled these hollows. Druids slept in the dens while connected to the Emerald Dream. After the Third War, the Shadow Council claimed the valley and named it for the demon lord Kil'jaeden. Renegade orc and Forsaken warlocks gathered there with satyrs, succubi, and felguards. They hold the surface ruins and deeper barrow dens, turning sacred woodland into a center for demonic rites.

sections.title: The Gates of the Shadow Hold
sections.body: Cultists gather at profane sites above ground, including the Shrine of the Deceiver. Braziers burn with fel flame, and rituals further corrupt the timberland. Below lies the entrance to the Shadow Hold, where the council's true masters direct their work across Felwood. The Emerald Sanctuary watches Jaedenar with concern. It regularly calls on daring wanderers to disrupt summoning circles and douse the dark flames sealing the tunnels.

faq.answer: The Shadow Council named Jaedenar in worship of Kil'jaeden the Deceiver, a supreme commander of the Burning Legion.
The Shadow Council controls Jaedenar. Its warlocks, chiefly orcs and Forsaken, serve the Burning Legion alongside summoned demons and corrupted satyrs.

faq.q: What was here before the demons arrived?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, ancient night elf ruins and peaceful druidic barrow dens stood here. Druids rested in the dens while roaming the Emerald Dream.
The Shadow Hold is a subterranean cavern system beneath Jaedenar and the fortified headquarters of the Shadow Council's leadership in Felwood. Its caverns were once druidic barrow dens.

angles.text: As a druid, you walk sacred ground laid waste. Jaedenar's barrows were once peaceful sanctuaries where druids communed with the Emerald Dream; now demonic ichor drowns them.
As a warlock, you see the Shadow Council's enduring presence on Azeroth in Jaedenar. Its warlocks openly summon powerful demons and wield volatile fel sorcery.
